items.description: Marvel Rivals makers NetEase have made their stance on cheating in the popular shooter abundantly clear in the studio's latest blog post, where it not only squashes rumours revolving the game's anti-cheat software but names (without directly doxing) and shames hundreds players who were caught using

items.description: The Intel Bartlett Lake flagship CPU may have additional P cores, but they do not bring any noticeable improvements in gaming. items.tldr: Intelの12 P-Coreを搭載したBartlett LakeフラッグシップCPUは、4年前のCore i9-13900Kに対するゲームベンチマークでの性能向上が見られず、ほとんどのテストで互角の結果となった。

items.title: Jason Voorhees Finally Stalks Into Dead by Daylight After Years of Fan Begging, Arriving on the Game’s 10th Anniversary
items.description: After ten years of Dead by Daylight fans begging developer Behaviour Interactive to add one of horror's most iconic slasher villains, as part of the game's 10th anniversary celebrations, Friday the 13th icon Jason Voorhees will join the game's growing roster of villains on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, wi
items.tldr: デッドバイデイライトの10周年を祝う中、ファンの要望に応え、ホラーの象徴的なスラッシャーキャラクター、ジェイソン・ボーヒーズが2026年6月16日にゲームに追加される。

items.title: Chinese GPU maker sells out over 30,000 gaming GPUs within 48 hours despite lukewarm benchmarks — LX 7G100 proves hype trumps performance
items.description: Lisuan Tech reports having sold out 30,,000 preorder LX 7G100 graphics cards with a second batch on June 18.

items.description: China’s largest semiconductor manufacturer, SMIC, is currently hindered by its failure to acquire advanced EUV machinery to mass produce wafers on the 5nm lithography or below. With no alternative to scale past this limitation, the need for innovation and creativity is absolutely vital, so a new 3D
items.tldr: HuaweiのKirin 9050は、AppleのA18 Proを上回る性能を持つと噂されており、古いプロセスノードの制限を回避するために新しい「スタッキング」技術を利用する予定です。

items.title: Subnautica 2 Early Access Tips and Tricks – Nine Tips I Wish I Knew Before Diving Into its Alien Ocean
items.description: Subnautica 2 has finally arrived in its early access state, and millions of players have excitedly dived into its alien ocean waters right away, only to find it incredibly overwhelming. items.tldr: Subnautica 2の早期アクセスが開始され、多くのプレイヤーがその異星の海に飛び込んでいますが、ゲームの複雑さに圧倒されることが多いです。初心者やシリーズに慣れたプレイヤー向けに、知っておくべき9つのヒントが紹介されています。

items.title: After LG, AOC Rolls Out Its First 1000 Hz Native FHD Gaming Monitor, Equipped With BLMB Technology
items.description: AOC fulfils its promise of releasing the first 1000 Hz 1080p gaming monitor that will trade blows with LG's offering. AOC Launches AGON PRO AGP257FT, its First-Ever Native 1080p Gaming Monitor That Can Hit 1000 Hz Refresh Rate AOC was the first monitor maker to announce a 1080p 1000 Hz monitor, even
items.tldr: AOCが初の1000 HzネイティブFHDゲーミングモニター「AGON PRO AGP257FT」を発表し、LGの製品と競争することを約束しました。

items.title: Imec builds world's first High-NA EUV-fabricated quantum dot qubit device — breakthrough could pull quantum computing onto the same manufacturing roadmap as next-gen AI processors, compressing timelines
items.description: Imec unveiled the world’s first silicon quantum dot qubit device fabricated with High-NA EUV lithography, suggesting quantum computing may eventually scale using the semiconductor industry’s existing advanced manufacturing ecosystem.
items.tldr: Imecが世界初のHigh-NA EUVリソグラフィーを用いて製造したシリコン量子ドットキュービットデバイスを発表し、量子コンピューティングが半導体産業の先進的な製造エコシステムを活用してスケールアップする可能性を示唆しました。

items.title: Testing GPU Safeguard+ on the MSI MPG Ai1600TS PSU – solution aims to tame melting 16-pin connectors
items.description: At CES 2026, MSI unveiled a new lineup of power supplies under its MPG and MAG series. The 2026 MPG models are available in 1600W and 1300W variants and feature server-grade SiC MOSFETs designed to deliver a high level of stability and power efficiency. However, the standout addition is GPU Safeguar
items.tldr: MSIはCES 2026で、MPGおよびMAGシリーズの新しい電源ユニットを発表し、特にGPU Safeguard+機能が16ピンコネクタの融解問題を解決することを目指しています。新しい1600Wおよび1300Wモデルは、サーバーグレードのSiC MOSFETを搭載し、高い安定性と電力効率を提供します。

items.title: Save up to $200 on a 13-inch or 15-inch MacBook Air with M5 chip and 16GB of RAM — Memorial Day discounts get you Apple's latest and best consumer laptop for as low as $899

items.tldr: メモリアルデーの割引により、M5チップと16GBのRAMを搭載した13インチまたは15インチのMacBook Airが最大200ドルオフで購入可能で、価格は899ドルから。

items.title: AOC’s New V6 Monitor Quadruples Its Refresh Rate At 1080p, Yet Stalls At Just 80Hz In 4K Mode
items.description: An interesting dual monitor from AOC, but it quadruples the refresh rate, making it ideal for competitive gaming. items.tldr: AOCの新しいV6モニターは、1080pでリフレッシュレートを4倍に向上させる一方、4Kモードでは80Hzに制限されています。競技用ゲームに最適なデュアルモードゲーミングモニターです。

items.title: California moves to exempt Linux from its upcoming age-verification law after backlash over forcing operating systems to collect users’ ages —  amendment proposed by the same lawmaker who wrote the original law
items.description: California lawmakers introduced a new amendment that could exempt most Linux distributions from the state’s upcoming Digital Age Assurance Act after privacy backlash and concerns that the law would force open-source operating systems to become age-verification platforms.
items.tldr: カリフォルニア州の議員が、プライバシーへの懸念を受けて、オープンソースのLinuxディストリビューションを州のデジタル年齢確認法から免除する修正案を提案した。

items.title: Star Citizen reaches $1 billion in lifetime funding, 14 years after the project was first announced — game still in early access with no release window, including 'Squadron 42' campaign
items.description: Star Citizen, originally announced back in 2012, has just amassed $1 billion in crowdfunding despite the game still not having any release date. The game is currently expected sometime in 2027-2028, which means it might have to prepare a PS6/Xbox Helix version as well. A single game spanning across
items.tldr: Star Citizenは2012年に発表され、現在までに10億ドルのクラウドファンディングを達成したが、リリース日が未定のまま早期アクセス中である。ゲームは2027-2028年にリリースされる可能性があり、次世代機への対応も考慮されている。

items.title: Huawei claims sanctions-busting breakthrough with 1.4nm-class chips by 2031, claims 55% higher transistor density — firm claims new LogicFolding chip architecture can bypass EUV restrictions, introduces 'Tau Scaling Law' to replace Moore's Law
items.description: Huawei Technologies unveiled a new “LogicFolding” chip design framework built on its proprietary Tau scaling law, claiming it can dramatically boost transistor density and power efficiency without EUV lithography — potentially helping China narrow the gap with TSMC and Nvidia despite U.S. sanctions.
items.tldr: Huaweiは、独自のTauスケーリング法に基づく新しい「LogicFolding」チップ設計フレームワークを発表し、EUVリソグラフィーなしでトランジスタ密度と電力効率を大幅に向上させると主張しており、2031年までに1.4nmクラスのチップを実現する計画です。

items.title: Super Flower Leadex 2800W ATX 3.1 power supply review: Top-notch build quality, exceptional efficiency
items.description: The Super Flower Leadex 2800W is a technical statement rather than a conventional product. It delivers extraordinary efficiency, exemplary power quality, and an internal design that leaves nothing on the table. The asking price is extreme, but so is everything else about this unit.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Super Flower Leadex 2800Wは、卓越した効率と優れた電力品質を提供する高性能ATX 3.1電源で、極端な価格に見合う優れた内部設計を特徴としています。

items.title: Researchers identify people through ordinary Wi-Fi routers with 99.5% accuracy — technique works with standard Wi-Fi routers
items.description: The system requires no specialized hardware, no access to the target Wi-Fi network, and works even if the person being tracked isn't carrying a wireless device.
items.tldr: 研究者たちは、標準的なWi-Fiルーターを使用して99.5%の精度で人を特定する技術を開発し、特別なハードウェアやターゲットのWi-Fiネットワークへのアクセスを必要とせず、追跡対象が無線デバイスを持っていなくても機能することを示しました。

items.title: Anthropic’s restricted Claude Mythos model may be coming to Claude Code
items.description: Anthropic appears to be preparing for the public rollout of the Mythos model, which was announced in April as a restricted model that poses major security risks to private and public software. [...]
items.tldr: Anthropicは、4月に発表されたセキュリティリスクの高い制限付きモデル「Mythos」の一般公開に向けた準備を進めているようです。

items.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Linux Flaws, Defender 0-Days, Router Botnets, and Supply Chain Chaos
items.description: Monday recap. Same mess, new week. A sketchy dev tool got people pwned, old bugs came back from the dead, and security products somehow needed protecting from themselves. items.tldr: TL;DR: 今週のセキュリティニュースでは、Linuxの脆弱性やDefenderの0-Day、ルーターのボットネット、サプライチェーンの混乱が報告され、企業は未修正の古いバグを再確認する必要に迫られました。

items.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
items.description: Authorities in the Netherlands have arrested the co-owners of two related Internet hosting companies for operating IT infrastructure used by Russia to carry out cyberattacks, influence operations and disinformation campaigns inside the European Union. The two men were the focus of a 2025 KrebsOnSecu
items.tldr: オランダ当局は、ロシアによるサイバー攻撃や情報操作に使用されるITインフラを運営していた関連するインターネットホスティング会社の共同所有者2名を逮捕し、800台のサーバーを押収しました。

items.title: FBI warns of Kali365 phishing service targeting Microsoft 365 accounts
items.description: The FBI is warning about the Kali365 phishing-as-a-service platform (PhaaS) that is used to hijack Microsoft 365 accounts by abusing OAuth device code authentication to steal session tokens and bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA). [...]
items.tldr: FBIは、OAuthデバイスコード認証を悪用してMicrosoft 365アカウントを乗っ取るKali365フィッシングサービス（PhaaS）について警告しています。

items.title: Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980 Exploited to Hijack 700+ Sites for ClickFix Attacks
items.description: Threat actors are exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Ghost CMS to inject malicious JavaScript code with an aim to fuel ClickFix attacks. items.tldr: Ghost CMSのCVE-2026-26980という重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が悪用され、700以上のサイトがClickFix攻撃のために悪意のあるJavaScriptコードを注入されている。

items.title: The Alert Firehose Finally Meets Its Match
items.description: Ask a cybersecurity pro about Network Detection and Response (NDR) and you might still hear "Noisy," "Too much data." But ask the teams running NDR that includes agentic AI capabilities and you'll hear they're actually using it to catch threats earlier, triage faster, and chase fewer false positives
items.tldr: NDRにエージェントAI機能を組み込んだチームは、脅威を早期に検出し、迅速にトリアージを行い、誤検知を減らすことに成功している。

items.title: Lazarus Deploys RemotePE Memory-Only RAT Against Financial and Crypto Firms
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have shed light on a cross-platform malware called RemotePE that has been put to use by the North Korea-linked Lazarus Group in attacks targeting financial and cryptocurrency organizations. RemotePE, per NCC Group subsidiary Fox-IT, is part of a multi-stage attack chain tha
items.tldr: 北朝鮮に関連するLazarus Groupが、金融および暗号通貨企業を標的にした攻撃で使用しているクロスプラットフォームのマルウェア「RemotePE」が明らかになりました。これは多段階攻撃の一部として機能しています。

items.title: TrapDoor Supply Chain Attack Spreads Credential-Stealing Malware via npm, PyPI, and CratesIO
items.description: A new coordinated cross-ecosystem software supply chain attack campaign has targeted npm, PyPI, and Crates.io to distribute credential-stealing malware. The campaign, codenamed TrapDoor, spans more than 34 malicious packages across over 384 versions. The earliest activity was recorded on May 22, 202
items.tldr: TrapDoorと名付けられた新たなソフトウェアサプライチェーン攻撃が、npm、PyPI、Crates.ioを通じて認証情報を盗むマルウェアを配布しており、34以上の悪意のあるパッケージが384以上のバージョンで確認されています。

items.title: Ghost CMS SQL injection flaw exploited in large-scale ClickFix campaign
items.description: A large-scale campaign is exploiting a critical SQL injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-26980) in Ghost CMS to inject malicious JavaScript code that triggers ClickFix attack flows. [...]
items.tldr: Ghost CMSの重大なSQLインジェクション脆弱性（CVE-2026-26980）が悪用され、大規模なClickFix攻撃キャンペーンが展開されている。

items.title: Laravel Lang packages hijacked to deploy credential-stealing malware
items.description: A supply chain attack targeting the Laravel Lang localization packages has exposed developers to a sophisticated credential-stealing malware campaign after attackers abused GitHub version tags to distribute malicious code through Composer packages. [...]
items.tldr: Laravel Langのローカリゼーションパッケージが標的にされたサプライチェーン攻撃により、攻撃者がGitHubのバージョンタグを悪用してComposerパッケージを通じて認証情報を盗むマルウェアを配布し、開発者が危険にさらされています。

items.title: npm Adds 2FA-Gated Publishing and Package Install Controls Against Supply Chain Attacks
items.description: GitHub has rolled out new controls for npm to improve the security of the software supply chain, giving maintainers the ability to explicitly approve a release prior to the packages becoming publicly available for installation. Called staged publishing, the feature is now generally available on npm.
items.tldr: npmは、ソフトウェアサプライチェーンのセキュリティを向上させるために、メンテイナーがパッケージの公開前にリリースを明示的に承認できる「ステージドパブリッシング」機能を一般提供開始しました。

items.title: Packagist Supply Chain Attack Infects 8 Packages Using GitHub-Hosted Linux Malware
items.description: A new "coordinated" supply chain attack campaign has impacted eight packages on Packagist including malicious code designed to run a Linux binary retrieved from a GitHub Releases URL. "Although the affected packages were all Composer packages, the malicious code was not added to composer.json," Sock
items.tldr: Packagistでの新たな供給連鎖攻撃により、GitHubホスティングのLinuxマルウェアを使用した8つのパッケージが感染し、Composerパッケージに悪意のあるコードが追加されましたが、composer.jsonには含まれていませんでした。

items.title: Italy disrupts CINEMAGOAL piracy app that stole streaming auth codes
items.description: Italian authorities have dismantled a piracy ecosystem centered around the CINEMAGOAL app that provided access to various streaming platforms, including Netflix, Disney+, and Spotify. [...]
items.tldr: イタリア当局は、NetflixやDisney+、Spotifyなどへのアクセスを提供するCINEMAGOALアプリを中心とした海賊行為のエコシステムを解体しました。

items.title: Claude Mythos AI Finds 10,000 High-Severity Flaws in Widely Used Software
items.description: Anthropic on Friday disclosed that Project Glasswing has helped uncover more than 10,000 high- or critical-severity vulnerabilities across some of the most "systemically" important software across the world since the cybersecurity initiative went live last month. Project Glasswing is a defensive eff
items.tldr: TL;DR: AnthropicのProject Glasswingが、先月の開始以来、世界中の重要なソフトウェアにおいて10,000以上の高・重大な脆弱性を発見したことを発表しました。

items.title: Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised to Deliver Cross-Platform Credential Stealer
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged a fresh software supply chain attack campaign that has targeted multiple PHP packages belonging to Laravel-Lang to deliver a comprehensive credential-stealing framework. The affected packages include - laravel-lang/lang laravel-lang/http-statuses laravel-lang/a
items.tldr: Laravel-Langの複数のPHPパッケージがサイバー攻撃により侵害され、包括的な資格情報窃取フレームワークが配布されていることが報告されました。

items.title: LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin CVE-2026-48172 Exploited to Run Scripts as Root
items.description: A maximum-severity security vulnerability impacting LiteSpeed User-End cPanel Plugin has come under active exploitation in the wild. items.title: Netherlands seizes 800 servers of hosting firm enabling cyberattacks

items.title: Lawmakers Demand Answers as CISA Tries to Contain Data Leak

items.title: Akamai Joins Growing Chorus of Vendors Betting Big on Secure Enterprise Browsers
items.description: When Akamai announced its LayerX acquisition, the company joined a growing list of vendors adding secure enterprise browsers to their product portfolios.
